liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playin' In The Band** (4 reviews): Reviewer finds this Playin' intensely hot, with Garcia playing at a fiery peak; Reviewer calls this Playin' long and engaging [5][6][15][16]
- **Eyes Of The World** (3 reviews): Eyes builds tension and then breaks loose; reviewer finds it close to their all-time favorite version; Reviewer rates this Eyes among the best of 1973, or of any year [10][15][16]
- **Morning Dew** (2 reviews): Show opens with a long, beautiful, powerful Morning Dew; Opening Dew is slow and beautiful, stretching time; cowboy songs follow [8][13]
- **Black Throated Wind** (1 review): Reviewer ranks this Black Throated Wind among the best versions of the song [8]
- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): Played at a faster tempo, as was usual then; Garcia moves fluidly through the chord changes [6]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (1 review): Reviewer calls this Here Comes Sunshine long and engaging [6]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-11-30.124131.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 179 min; rated 4.58/5 by 19 [1]
- **gd73-11-30.aud.vernon.17277.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 163 min; rated 3.91/5 by 11 [3]. Said about its sound: Audience recording has audible hiss and needed the volume turned well up; Audience recording sounds thin and muffled, though the Eyes still carries plenty of energy; Audience recording has a raw quality that the reviewer enjoys [8][9][10][14]
- **gd73-11-30.sbd.vernon.8099.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 175 min; rated 4.62/5 by 13 [2]
- **gd1973-11-30.155310.aud.partial.flac1644**: audience recording; 7 songs; 44 min [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says the show is less legendary than the 12/2 show but has many highlights [15]
- Reviewer says the show is less legendary than the 12/2 show but has many highlights [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-11-30.124131.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by dusborne; source: 2 source matrix by dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:8099) sbd > ? > CDR > EAC(secure) > mkwact(seekable) and Audience (shnid:17277) Source: AUDMC(unknown mics) > ?… [1]. Also: This date appears on Dick's Picks 14; show information is embedded in the FLAC file headers [1]
- **gd73-11-30.aud.vernon.17277.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Unknown; source: Audience Recording [3]
- **gd73-11-30.sbd.vernon.8099.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1973-11-30.155310.aud.partial.flac1644**: taped by John Petrunis; transferred by Transferred by Andrew F. 01/2022; source: Unknown mono AUD, rescued from ebay with thanks to John Petrunis. [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Boston Music Hall - November 30, 1973](https://www.dead.net/show/november-30-1973) [18]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1973-11-30 Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1973-11-30-ticket/) [19]
